Hwɛ mfa ntafo fã no ne wo ne obi bom. Wo nsusuwii sɛ ɔkyɛn biara yɛ nea ɛde ne ho?
Di fã wɔ nifa so, afei di nea ɛfa nifa so a ɛfa ho. Ɛbɛyɛ adwuma nso sɛ wosan yɛ saa.
Fã a ɛfa ho bom no wɔ abɔ kɛse ne aboa. Fã a ɛnfa ho no kyɛ bio, na wubetumi ahwehwɛ foforɔ.
Di "Ma me hu" sɛnea wopɛ, afei di "Nhyehyɛe foforɔ" ma mfonini foforɔ.
tips: Fa wo nsa tu so ɛkɔ fã no anim. Wɛ, nsɛnkyerɛnne no kɔ mfimfini?
Ka nea wuhu kyerɛ: "Ɛno wɔ kɛtɛɛ." Ɛnhia sɛ wotwe mfonini biara din.
Sɛ wobɛtwa ankasa a ɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wobɛtwe ntɛm. Fa mo ho mu ntem wɔ ahyɛnsode no so na mo mu biara nhu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ ɔberɛsɛm anaa nsɛnkyerɛnne?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni dwumadi, nsɛnkyerɛnne, ntentan kuruwa anaa ɔhwehwɛ. Wubetumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wugyae ne ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan a ɛfata sɛ wubegyae.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛba sɛ fã abien nfa ho?
faq.a: Biribiara a ɛbɛyɛ wo haw nni hɔ. Ɛnni nsɔsɛm, ɛnni ɔkɔkɔɔ ntaban anaa ahoɔfɛ. Fã abien no kyɛ bio, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no ka sɛ, "Saa mmienu yi nfa ho. Hwehwɛ foforɔ." Wɔnkan biribiara.

faq.q: Mfonini no yɛ mmerɛ sɛ wobɛka wɔn ho ayɛ?
faq.a: Aane. Wɔpaw mfonini no de nsa, na ɛnyɛ mfonini abien a efi nkyekyɛmu baako mu wɔ sɛdeɛ kanea biara, sɛnea aba abien anaa mmoa abien. Mfonini a wɔn fã abien hwɛ sɛ ɛte pɛpɛɛpɛ, sɛnea osian anaa ɔpɔtweaa, no wɔyi firi mu.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ krataa so nhyehyɛe ana?
faq.a: Ee. Ɔpeɛ a wɔde ahyɛ mu, hɔ de mfonini abien ɛwɔ no ɛnyinam mfã a ɛwɔ baguan mu ne ɛnyinam mfã a ɛwɔ nifa mu, nanso wɔahyehyɛ mu foforo. Fa ahyɛ ɛnyinam mfã biara ne ɛfata ne ho no ntam.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ bebree a na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Ɛyɛ bebree, na ɛnhia akaunt, kyerɛw din anaa ɛfiri Intanɛt ase. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔbrowsa a ɛwɔ fon, tablet anaa kɔmputa so.

color-by-number.name: Color by number
color-by-number.seoTitle: Color by Number: a Calm Large-Print Fill Game
color-by-number.h1: Color by Number: Fill the Squares, Any Color You Like
color-by-number.description: A grid of large numbered squares and a key of four colors with their names. Choose a color, then tap squares to fill them. Any color is fine, there is no timer or score, and a button fills the rest by the numbers. Free to play and print.
color-by-number.short: Choose a color, then tap the numbered squares to fill them.
color-by-number.intro: A square grid of large squares, each with a number, and a key above it with four colors, each with its number and its written name. Choose a color from the key, then tap squares to fill them. The grid is 4 by 4 to start, with 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 when you want more squares. When every square has the color of its number, the grid is the picture on the sheet. Squares filled with any other color are simply your own picture, and the game says nothing about it. "Fill with the numbers" fills every empty square for you.
howTo: Choose the grid size. 4 by 4 has the biggest squares and is the simplest.
Look at the key above the grid. Each color has a number and a name, such as 1 Yellow.
Tap a color in the key, then tap the squares you would like to fill with it.
Use the color on the number, or any color you like. Both are fine.
Tap "Fill with the numbers" for the empty squares, "Clear" to start the grid again, or "Another picture" for a different one.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person chooses the color, the other taps the square.
Talk about the colors: "I like the green." There is no need to name what the picture will be.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
The paper version works as well with pencils at a bedside table.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What if I use a different color from the number?
faq.a: Nothing happens, and that is the point. Any color can go in any square, and the game says nothing about it. When every square has the color of its number the game says so gently, and a picture in your own colors is just as good.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a number, a written name and its own small shape, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four fills were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness, and they also differ in lightness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 48 pixels across, and 56 on the 4 by 4 grid. If a grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has a numbered grid and the key of four colors with their names. Color each square with a pencil of the color on its number, or any color you like.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

pattern-maker.name: Pattern maker
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile and Print the Pattern
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile, See It Repeat
pattern-maker.description: Change the squares of one small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern beside it, in four colors that each have a name and a shape. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
pattern-maker.short: Change the squares of a small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern.
pattern-maker.intro: A small tile of 3 by 3 squares, or 4 by 4 if you like, and beside it "your pattern": the same tile repeated in a block. Tap a square and it changes to the next of four colors, each with its own written name and shape. The pattern beside it changes at once. There is no right pattern and nothing is saved or sent. "Print my pattern" puts the repeated pattern on one page to keep, color in or give away.
howTo: Look at the tile and at your pattern beside it. They are the same tile, repeated.
Tap a square. It changes to the next color in the row of four colors above.
Keep tapping squares until the pattern looks the way you would like. Any pattern is a good one.
Tap "Surprise me" for a new tile, or "Start again" for a clear one. "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.
Tap "Print my pattern" if you would like it on paper, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person taps a square, the other says what they notice.
Ka wo ho ano ka ho: "Ɛte sɛ ɔdua." Ɛho hia sɛ wobɔ ade din biara.
Try the same tile in just two colors, then again in all four.
On paper, the pattern can be colored in with pencils, cut into strips for a card, or used to wrap a small gift.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything I make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Your tile stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep a pattern, print it.

faq.q: What if I tap the wrong square or clear the tile by accident?
faq.a: There is no wrong square: tap it again to move on to the next color. After "Start again" or "Surprise me", "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each square, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 56 pixels across. If the tile is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print my pattern" prints the pattern you made on one page, with the four colors and their names, fine in black and white because every color has its own shape.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Two People Build One Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Two People, One Grid
build-together.description: Two people take turns to put a piece in a shared grid until it is full, each with a color of their own that has a name and a shape. Nobody wins, and there is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
build-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to fill one shared grid.
build-together.intro: A shared grid of 4 by 4 places, or 3 by 3 if you like. Each of you picks a color, and each color has its own written name and shape. You take turns: on your turn, tap an empty place to put your piece there. When every place has a piece, the picture is built together. There is no winner, because you make it as a pair, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print the grid" puts an empty grid on one page so you can build with two pencils.
howTo: Each of you picks a color. A color the other person has is marked "In use".
The first person goes first. The screen says whose turn it is and which color is theirs.
Tap an empty place to put your piece there. The turn passes to the other person.
If you would rather not place a piece, tap "Pass". Either of you may pass at any time.
When every place has a piece, you have built the picture together. Tap "Start again" to build another, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side so you can both see and reach the screen. Talk as you go: "I will put mine next to yours."
Try to build a pattern, stripes, a checkerboard or a border, or just place pieces anywhere you like. Both are fine.
A child or a person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The picture is still built together.
On paper, each person uses one pencil and draws their own shape in the empty squares.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you build one picture together. There is no clock, score, count of pieces or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The grid stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page. If you would like to keep it, print the grid and build on paper.

faq.q: What if I put a piece in the wrong place?
faq.a: There is no wrong place. Tap "Take back the last piece" and the turn goes back to you. You can take back one step at a time, and a pass can be taken back too.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a written name and its own small shape in each piece, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four colors were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every place is at least 56 pixels across. If the grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the places.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Aane. "Prin grid no" prints grid a ɛnni biribiara mu wɔ axɛ baako so, ne ɔhɔho mmienu ne wɔn din, na ɛma mo mfa peŋsel mmienu ahyɛ so. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tuntum ne fitaa mu, efisɛ ɔhɔho biara wɔ ne sɛdeɛ ankasa.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din ansa?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din ahyɛ mu anaa nkɔsoɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ fon, tablet anaa komputa so.

seated-toss.name: Tebel so ntwa tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Tebel so Ntwa Tally: Bean-Bag Akyɛde Ma Nnipa 2
seated-toss.h1: Tebel so Ntwa Tally: Monntɔ Bom Wɔ Tebel Ho
seated-toss.description: Nnipa mmienu wɔ tebel ho tɔ bean bag a ɛyɛ nwini kɔ target kɛse mu, na wɔde tally kɔ paper so. Biribiara nnyina bere anaa nkontaabu. Ɛyɛ ahofadi sɛ wobɛprin.
seated-toss.short: Monwa mu tɔ bean bag kɔ target kɛse mu, na tally wɔ paper so.
seated-toss.intro: Ɛyɛ ntwa a ɛnyɛ ahaw, ɛma nnipa mmienu a wɔtena tebel ho. Wode target a wɔaprin no bɛda tebel no so, na mo mu biara tɔ bean bag a ɛyɛ nwini, anaa sɔks a wɔawia, sɛ ɛbɛkɔ ring no mu. Mo mu biara de tick kyerɛ box wɔ paper so, na sɛ mogyae a, mo nyinaa hwɛ ticks no. Wɔnnyina bere, wɔnnkan nkontaabu wɔ screen so, na wɔnsie anaa wɔnsoma biribiara. Kenkan safety notes no ansa: nneɛma ketewa a ɛwɔ mu yɛ asiane.
howTo: Kenkan safety notes no. Yi bag a ne kata wɔadi mu yie, anaa sɔks a ɛyɛ hɔ tɔ no mu.
Fa "Prin target ne tally sheet" na de paper no to tebel no so mo ntam.
Tena ahodoɔ mu, mo mu baako wɔ fam biara, na monwa mu tɔ bom nnyiɛ mu. Obiara tumi gyae.
Sɛ bean bag no ka ring bi mu a, fa tick kɔ box a ɛwɔ wo kɔlɔm no mu, wɔ saa ring no kɔlɔm no mu.
Sɛ mugyae a, mo nyinaa hwɛ ticks no, anaa fa "Ahome" ma ɛsiesie.
tips: Tena mu nkyerɛ ahinhim sɛ tɔ a ɛyɛ nwini no tumi ka target no a wɔnnnyɛ ntɔnsɛ biara.
Ka tɔ no ho asɛm, na ɛnyɛ nea ɛba: "Ɛno yɛ tɔ a ɛyɛ nwini." Nnipa nyinaa ma tɔ biara ayɛ ahurusi.
Sɔks a wɔawia yɛ kɔkɔɔ, na ɛyɛ sɛ wobɛkyere no ɛwɔ wo nsa mu a ɛnyɛ den. Fa wo nsa to tebel no so ntam nnwa a moreyɛ.
Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔhwɛ, ɔtumi yɛ nea ɔbɛde tick kɔ box no.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni sɔkoo, nkontaabu, nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so anaa ahinhim. Wobɛtumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa de awie.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahoɔfɛ sɛ wɔtɔ bean bag?
faq.a: Ɛbɛyɛ, sɛ wobɛhwɛ yie. Fa bag a ne kata wɔadi mu yie anaa sɔks a wɔawia, na mma nneɛma a ɛnyɛ mmoa, mfuw anaa nneɛma ketewa, efisɛ ɛbɛyɛ asiane ma mmofra ketewa ne obiara a ɔde nneɛma guan ne nsa mu. Tena wo ho, tɔ gyinaa tebel no so yie, na mma wo tɔ anifuo, na ma ɔpanin bi nɔ ho ntɛm.

faq.q: Wɔbɛkan biribiara anaa wɔbɛsie biribiara wɔ screen so?
faq.a: Dabi. Tally no wɔ paper so nko, wɔ box a mo ankasa motwa tick no mu. Ɛpeeji no nnyina kan anaa bere, na wɔnsie biribiara, na wɔnsoma biribiara.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi remfa mtɔ, anaa bag no ka sɛ ɛnkɔ paper no so?
faq.a: Obiara tumi gyae, na bag a ɛka sɛ ɛnkɔ paper no so no, wɔfa de ahyɛ ntwa a ɛdi hɔ no. Wɔnkan biribiara ama no.

faq.q: Dɛn na ɛwɔ paper a wɔaprin no so?
faq.a: Axɛ baako: target kɛse a ne ring 3 din de Ɛbɛn, Mfinimfini ne Akyirikyiri, tebel a kɔlɔm biara ma obi biara ne nkyɛn a ɛyɛ box ketewa a wobɛtwa tick ma ring biara, ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa safety ho. Wɔakyerɛw din no wɔ ring no so, enti ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tuntum ne fitaa mu.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din ansa?
faq.a: Aane, ɛyɛ ahofadi, na ɛnhia akaunt, din ahyɛ mu anaa nkɔsoɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ web browser a ɛwɔ fon, tablet anaa komputa so.

story-dice.name: Asɛm dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Asɛm Dice: Mfonini Ntwa a Wɔde Kyerɛ Asɛm
story-dice.h1: Asɛm Dice: Ka Asɛm Bi Kyerɛ Wɔ Mfonini So
story-dice.description: Mfonini dice 3 anaa 4 a wɔde kyerɛ asɛm wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu. Ɛnhia sɛ wokenkan, nni mmuae a ɛteɛ, nni bere, nni nkontaabu. Mɔ dice no bio, anaa gyae. Ɛyɛ ahofadi sɛ wobɛtena anaa wobɛprin.
story-dice.short: Mɔ mfonini dice na mo nyinaa ka asɛm bi, wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu.
story-dice.players: Nnipa 2 anaa nnipa pii, anaa ɔpanin ne abofra
story-dice.intro: Mfonini 3 anaa 4 bɛda adi sɛ dice. Mo nyinaa mu ka asɛm bi a ɛde ano, wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu. Asɛm no tumi yɛ tiaa anaa ɛyɛ nea ɛda nokware so. Asɛm pɛyɛ nni hɔ, na obiara nhia sɛ ɔkyerɛ din anaa ɔkae biribiara. Fa "Mɔ dice no bio" ma mfonini foforɔ, na obiara tumi gyae.
howTo: Yi dice 3 anaa 4. 3 ne ɛyɛ mmerɛ.
Mo nyinaa hwɛ mfonini no. Fa baako sɛ wopɛ sɛ mofi ase wɔ so.
Monwa mu ka asɛm a ɛde mfonini no, wɔ nhyehyɛe biara mu. Asɛm baako ma obiara na ɛboro so.
Obiara tumi gyae. Fa "Gyae" na ɛdi hɔ a ɛbɛdi so no bɛfi ase.
Fa "Mɔ dice no bio" ma mfonini foforɔ bere biara a wopɛ, anaa fa "Ahome" ma ɛba awieɛ.
tips: Bisa asɛmmisa sɛ ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛtɔ mmuae bio: "Ntoma no bɛkɔ he?"
Ka nea ɔdi kan no ho ka ho, kyerɛ mmom sɛ wobɛsesa no. Asɛm biara yɛ.
Asɛm bi bɛtumi ayɛ ɔkae a ɛyɛ nokware. Mfonini yɛ ɔkwan pa a wɔfi ase so.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nkontaabu?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛnni sɔkoo, nkontaabu, nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so anaa ahinhim. Wobɛtumi agyae bere biara, na sɛ wogyae ɛkyɛn a, ɛyɛ ɔkwan pa a wobɛfa de awie.

faq.q: Ɛsɛ sɛ mekenkan anaa mekyerɛ din ma mfonini no?
faq.a: Dabi. Ɛdwuma nko ara wɔ mfonini no so. Nnipa tumi ka, kyerɛkyerɛ anaa kɔka nea mfonini no kae ama wɔn nkutoo. Obiara nhyɛ no sɛ ɔkyerɛ din anaa ɔkae biribiara.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi remfa ne bere nnwa?
faq.a: WanƐ hia no, wobɛtumi apue bere biara a enni nkyerɛkyerɛ. Ɛnam so, kɔ so, na nea ɛbɛtoa so no betumi afi ase anaasɛ wosan mfa ntetekɔ.

faq.q: Ɛwɔ kwan a wɔfa mpapahwɛ so yɛ no?
faq.a: Yiw. Mpapahwɛ baako wɔ mfonini ahodoɔ a ɛyɛ dodow 16 wɔ nsɛnkyeneɛ 4 mu. Fa nsɛnkyeneɛ baako, anaasɛ sɛ wotwa mfonini no, na wɔde bi aba mu ma wo.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛhia sɛ woyɛ kwan a wobɛka?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛnhia akaunt, nkyerɛwbɔ anaasɛ sɛ wode bɛtow. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔhwɛfo (web browser) so wɔ fon, tabelɛt anaasɛ kɔmpiuta so.

sort-together.name: Bom hyehyɛ mu
sort-together.seoTitle: Nhyehyɛe Agyinatuo: Hyehyɛ Mmoa Ma Nkurɔfo Akɛse
sort-together.description: Fa mfonini biara, then akyiri kɔ kɛntɛn a ɛfata ho: ɛdan anaa akuraa, aduaba anaa mmoa. Agyinatuo a ɛyɛ dwodwo a wɔntua sika, ma nkurɔfo akɛse ne mmusuakuw.
sort-together.short: Fa mfonini biara gu ne kɛntɛn mu: adididan anaa turo, ne nea ɛkeka ho.
sort-together.intro: Nneɛma a wɔhyehyɛ no yɛ da biara da adwuma a wonim no yiye na ɛma abotɔyam, te sɛ nneɛma a wɔde bɛto nkyɛn anaasɛ sɔks a wɔde bɛka abom. Kɔ mfonini bi so, afei pia kɛntɛn no so wɔ baabi a ɛfata. Aperepere biara nni hɔ na ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ biara nni hɔ.
howTo: Paw asɛmti bi: aduannoa ne turo, nnuaba ne mmoa, anaa ofie ne akwantu.
Kɔ mfonini bi so. Ɛnya sika kɔkɔɔ hyeɛ.
Kɔ kɛntɛn a ɛyɛ mu de no so Mfonini no kɔ saa kɛntɛn no mu.
Sɛ ɛyɛ kɛntɛn foforo no dea a, agoru no ka saa brɛoo na ɛtwɛn.
Sɛ wɔhyehyɛ mfonini biara a, mobom hwɛ nketewa no mu.
tips: Mpɛn pii no, mmuae a ɛnteɛ biara nni asetra ankasa mu. Sɛ obi ka sɛ nsuo a wɔde gu mu yɛ ne dea wɔ adididan mu a, bisa nea enti a ɛte saa. Ebia wubenya asɛm pa bi.
Fa mfonini ahorow no di dwuma sɛ nea ɛkanyan wo: "Dɛn na wuduae wɔ wo turo mu?"
Nneɛma ankasa a wɔhyehyɛ, te sɛ nkankyee ne kyɛnsee anaa bɔton ahorow sɛnea kɔla te no yɛ akyidi kɛse a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri fi screen no so.

faq.q: So bere nhyehyɛe anaasɛ nkontaahyɛde bi wɔ hɔ?

Sɛ obi wɔ ɔhome mu haw a, home sɛnea ɛsɛ na hwɛ kurukuruwa no ara kwa. Bisa oduruyɛfo bi fa ɔhome ho haw biara ho.

faq.q: So eyi yɛ aduruyɛ mu ahomegye apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ?
faq.a: Dabi, ɛyɛ home a ɛnyɛ den a obi betumi apaw a ɛbɛma woayɛ komm na woayɛ fekubɔ. Ɛnyɛ dadwen anaa tebea biara a wɔde sa yare. Wo ne oduruyɛfo nkasa mfa akwahosan ho haw ahorow ho.

faq.q: So kurukuruwa no tu a memfa mfi ase?
faq.a: Dabi Biribiara ntumi nkɔ kosi sɛ wobɛbɔ Start, na egyina bere a woahome asia akyi anaasɛ bere a woabɔ Stop no. Sɛ wɔahyɛ wo mfiri no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛtew kankyee so a, nsɛmfua no sesa a kurukuruwa no nnyin.

faq.q: So ɛyɛ nea wontua hwee, na so ɛsɛ sɛ mekyerɛw me din?
faq.a: Yiw, wontua hwee, na akontaabu, sign-up anaa download biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wɛb brawsa mu wɔ fon, tablɛt anaa kɔmputa so.

story-chain.name: Abakɔsɛm Nhyehyɛe
story-chain.seoTitle: Abakɔsɛm Nhyehyɛe: Agyinatuo a Mfonini Ma Abakɔsɛm Wɔ Nkabom Mu
story-chain.h1: Abakɔsɛm Nhyehyɛe: Ka Abakɔsɛm Mfonini Biako Biako
story-chain.description: Mfonini ntoatoa bɛkɔ so biako biako, na obiara ka asɛm baako ka ho gyigyi. Ɛnhia sɛ wotwe nsɛm, mmuae a ɛteɛ biara nni hɔ. Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, ɛyɛ dwodwo, nni bere, na nni nkontabuo.
story-chain.short: Fa mfonini foforo ka ho, afei obiara ka asɛm baako, ɛnam ntoatoaso so.
story-chain.players: Nkurɔfo baako anaa sɛ ɛboro ɛno
story-chain.intro: Agyinatuo no fi mfonini baako ase, na ɛnam mfonini biako biako so kɔ so de abakɔsɛm nhyehyɛe no bɛkɔ so. Obiara ka asɛm baako ka abakɔsɛm a ɛreba no ho gyigyi, ka so, ntoatoaso so. Asɛm no betumi afa nea wohu, beaa a ɛma wokae, anaa biribi a ɛyɛ ɛbɛyɛ nwonwa. Wɔntwe nsɛm, wɔnkyerɛw anaa wɔnkora, nni mmuae a ɛteɛ biara, na obiara betumi apue. Nhyehyɛe no bɛsiesie wɔ mfonini mmienu so, afei wobɛtumi afi foforo ase.
howTo: Hwɛ mfonini a ɛdi kan no ne nkurɔfo.
Momfa ntoatoaso: obiara ka asɛm baako ka abakɔsɛm a ɛreba no ho gyigyi. Obiara betumi apue.
Fa nsa frɛ "Fa mfonini foforo ka ho" de mfonini a ɛdi so no ba nhyehyɛe no awiei.
Fa nsa frɛ "Yi nea ɛdi akyiri no fi hɔ" sɛ wopɛ sɛ wɔsan kɔ mfonini a atwa so kan.
Sɛ abakɔsɛm no wɔ mfonini mmienu so a, fa nsa frɛ "Fi abakɔsɛm foforo ase" ma abakɔsɛm foforo, anaasɛ kɔ so ara gyae.
tips: Ɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔka nsɛm tiaa: "Obi de nsuo ahyɛ kettle no mu." Obi a ɛdi so no bɛtoa so, anaasɛ wapue.
Ma mfonini no nkyerɛ kwan. Abakɔsɛm biara nni hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ wobɛka.
Gyae bere biara a wɔpɛ. Gyae wɔ hann mu nso yɛ kwan a ɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔbɛtwe ase."

faq.q: Ɛwɔ bere anaa nhwɛso biara?
faq.a: Nni. Ɛnni bere, nhwɛso, ntuatua ɔkwan anaa nkɔhyɛ. Wobetumi agyae bere biara, na gyae wɔ hann mu nso yɛ kwan a ɛyɛ yie sɛ wɔbɛtwe ase.

faq.q: Wɔkyerɛw anaa wɔkora biribiara?
faq.a: Nni. Wɔka nsɛm no ase, na wɔnkyerɛw, wɔnkora anaa wɔnsoma kɔ baabi biara. Agyinatuo no kyerɛ mfonini nko.

faq.q: Dɛn sɛ obi ampɛ sɛ ɔka biribiara?
faq.a: Obiara betumi apue, na obi a ɛdi so no kɔ so. Obiara nhia sɛ ɔfrɛ mfonini bi anaa ɔkae mfonini bi.

faq.q: Ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛhia sɛ woyɛ kwan a wobɛka?
faq.a: Yiw, ɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na ɛnhia akaunt, nkyerɛwbɔ anaasɛ sɛ wode bɛtow. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔhwɛfo (web browser) so wɔ fon, tabelɛt anaasɛ kɔmpiuta so.
